name: Gassam
title: Ancestor of a temple servant family
summary: Gassam was the ancestor of a family of temple servants (netinim) who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. His descendants are mentioned among those who returned with Zerubbabel to rebuild the temple and restore worship in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the temple servants in the book of Ezra
keyEvents.description: Gassam's descendants are mentioned among the families of temple servants (netinim) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the temple servants in the book of Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Gassam's descendants are also listed in Nehemiah's register of those who returned from captivity, confirming the family's role in temple service.

keyEvents.title: The return of the temple servants to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The temple servants, including Gassam's family, were among the first to return to resume service in the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem and surrounding areas
keyEvents.description: The temple servants, including the descendants of Gazzam, settled near the temple to carry out their duties in the rebuilt house of God.
